channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Stafford Shields Data Centers from Tax Hike, Targets Homeowners
item.description: While advertising a six-cent increase in the real estate tax rate to $0.985 per $100 of assessed value for calendar year 2026—potentially adding about $430 annually to the average household bill—the Stafford County Board of Supervisors rejected a proposal to raise the personal property tax rate on data center computer equipment and peripherals from $1.25 to $2.50 per $100 of assessed value during its March 3, 2026 meeting.

item.title: Early Voting Begins Tomorrow for Virginia’s Special Redistricting Referendum
item.description: Early voting commences tomorrow, Friday, March 6, across Virginia for the April 21 special election on a proposed constitutional amendment concerning congressional redistricting.

item.title: Major Sentencing & Local Blotter: 21-Year Term in Woodbridge Drug Case; Gunshots in Woodbridge, Gainesville Break-In Attempt
item.description: Law enforcement agencies in Prince William and Stafford counties reported several incidents over the past few days, highlighting ongoing efforts to address public safety concerns ranging from firearm-related calls to burglaries and warrant services.

item.title: Virginia’s Unfunded Mandates Drive Stafford’s Proposed 6-Cent Real Estate Tax Increase, Officials Say
item.description: On March 3, 2026, the Stafford County Board of Supervisors voted 5-2 to advertise a real estate tax rate of $0.985 per $100 of assessed value for calendar year 2026 — an increase of six cents from the current $0.9236 rate — plus a modest rise in the fire and emergency services levy to $0.014 from $0.0131.

item.title: Sudden Closure of Concerted Care Group’s Stafford Clinic Leaves Patients Scrambling for Services
item.description: The Concerted Care Group (CCG) clinic in Stafford County, a key provider of opioid addiction treatment and behavioral health services, has abruptly closed its doors, according to a tip received by Potomac Local News today.

item.title: Police seek details, video after man, 19 killed in fiery I-66 crash
item.description: Virginia State Police are continuing their investigation into a fatal single-vehicle crash that claimed the life of a 19-year-old Bristow resident on Saturday, February 28, 2026, and are asking for the public's assistance.

item.title: Virginia Health Department Partially Lifts Potomac River Advisory
item.description: The Virginia Department of Health (VDH) announced that it is partially lifting a recreational water advisory for the Potomac River, effective immediately.

item.title: Paws for Healing: SNVMC’s Therapy Dog Program Grows to Five, Bringing Comfort to Patients and Staff
item.description: Sentara Northern Virginia Medical Center (SNVMC) has expanded its therapy dog program from one to five certified therapy dogs over the past year.

item.title: Salvation Army Relocates to Woodbridge Shopping Center
item.description: The Salvation Army has successfully relocated its thrift store from its former site in Gordon Plaza to a prominent new space at Woodbridge Shopping Center, strengthening its presence in the community.

item.title: Your Water Bill Could Rise: Stafford Advances Rate Increases While Data Centers Help Pay for New Pipes
item.description: The Stafford County Board of Supervisors unanimously authorized advertising public hearings on March 3, 2026, for proposed adjustments to water, sewer, and reclaimed water rates, including new fees designed to recover costs from data center-related infrastructure while introducing equity measures for commercial users.
